Subject: Hosted API trial onramp — quickstart ops agenda & rate limits

Hi Anita —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can get your team into a Hosted API trial sandbox: 

1) Quickstart items (we attached a one-page checklist):
   - Sandbox endpoints (staging) + API key provisioning
   - Short-lived rate slices for parallel testing (slicing guidance below)
   - Prefix/KV cache warmup plan for your top 20 prompt templates

2) Info we need from Finlytics to provision the trial:
   - Expected peak concurrent requests per second (RPS) and token rate (we can use sample CSV)
   - Which features you need: streaming, function calling, embeddings, or only generation
   - Any IP allowlist or egress constraints for your network team

3) Rate-limit proposal for trial (configurable, can be adjusted after baseline):
   - Staging endpoint: 120 requests/min per API key with 8 concurrent streams
   - Token rate soft cap: 60k tokens/min with automated backoff (alerts to both teams)

Next actions:
- Anita: share a representative traffic sample (CSV) and confirm which features to enable.
- Ben: will provision staging endpoints and attach a short ops playbook in Drive.
- Marissa: coordinate a brief sandbox runbook for your SREs and security question list.

Attachment: redwood-quickstart-checklist.pdf (application/pdf, 110KB)

If that looks good I can spin up the sandbox today and we can schedule a 30-min run-through with your SREs.

Thanks —
Vivek

Thanks Vivek — this is helpful and aligns with what we discussed. A few clarifying Qs before we send the traffic sample: 

- Can you lower the initial requests/min to 60 for the first 48h while we smoke-test service behaviors? We want to exercise concurrency but limit blast radius.
- For token caps: can we set a per-request token cap (e.g., 2,048) and have a leakage alert if we exceed 50k tokens/min?

I'll attach the CSV (sample from March–April) in a follow-up. Also, our security team will ask for the sandbox endpoint FQDN and your IPs for allowlisting.

If the lower initial rate is fine, go ahead and provision, and we'll book the run-through for Wed morning PST.

—Anita

On Mon, May 3, 2027 at 4:02 PM Anita Rao <anita@finlytics.com> wrote:
> Can you lower the initial requests/min to 60 for the first 48h while we smoke-test service behaviors?

Hi Anita — yes, we can do that. Proposed adjusted trial config below (can be tuned after the first 24h):

- Day 0–2: 60 requests/min per key, 6 concurrent streams, per-request token cap 2,048.
- Day 3+: bump to 120 requests/min and up to 8 concurrent streams if health metrics look good.
- Token monitoring: we will wire an SLA-style leakage alert to your ops channel at 50k tokens/min; also enable per-key dashboards for token burn.

I've provisioned a stub staging endpoint and created the sandbox access doc in Drive: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1A2B3C4D
Attachment: finlytics-mock-traffic-jan-may.csv (text/csv, 42KB)

Vivek — I'll hand the ops playbook to you for the run-through. Anita — can you confirm Wed 10:00 AM PST for the 30-min session?

Thanks,
Ben
